title: Video Editor
mission: Turn raw footage into clear, polished videos that fit the brand and finish on time.
outcomes_90_days: Deliver the first edited video in the first month with feedback reduced to one round.
Build reusable project templates, caption styles and an export checklist.
Keep a steady weekly output the team agrees on.
Organize raw footage and finished files in a folder structure anyone can find.

gates.question: Can the person legally work in the country of the role?
Does the person have a computer and software that can handle the editing the role needs, or will the company supply it?

deal_breakers.description: Says they routinely use music or footage without a license.
deal_breakers.job_related_reason: Unlicensed media can lead to takedowns and legal claims.

work_sample.title: Edit a short clip
work_sample.brief: You get 4 minutes of fictional raw footage of a person explaining a topic, plus a one page brief. Deliver a 45 to 60 second cut with captions, and a note listing your choices. The clip must not use music you do not have rights to.
work_sample.how_to_score: Score hook, pacing, cuts on word boundaries, readable captions, clean audio, license safe music, and a clear note.

interview_questions.question: Walk me through how you edit a 10 minute interview into a 60 second clip.
good_answer_signs: Starts from the message, then picks lines
weak_answer_signs: Only trims the start and end

interview_questions.question: Tell me about a week with several deadlines at once. How did you manage them?
What do you change in the first 3 seconds of a video, and why?
good_answer_signs: Puts the point or the question first

red_flags: Portfolio pieces are not theirs or not credited
Only works on one platform and cannot adapt
sourcing_channels: Film and media school alumni groups
pay_research_hint: Check freelance day or per video rates and salaried postings for video editors in your region. Ask for project based and monthly retainer quotes to compare.
automation_note: AI can cut silences, transcribe, create caption drafts and suggest clip highlights. A person controls story, taste, rights and the final export.
